title: ComfyUI-Photopea-tab: Sidebar Image Editor for ComfyUI
summary: Integrates the Photopea image editor as a dedicated sidebar tab in ComfyUI. It enables seamless bidirectional image transfers and layer-specific imports directly between the workspace and the editor.
research_notes: Includes a built-in ad-blocking toggle and supports importing individual layers or entire documents back into the graph.

evolution.summary: Established as the current standard for Photopea integration in ComfyUI, replacing earlier iframe-based versions. Ongoing development addresses UI scaling and stability in standalone application environments.
